hero.title: AI Development Company — Providence
hero.description: ClickMasters builds custom AI for Providence's healthcare, financial services, defense technology, and biotech organizations — Rhode Island's capital city where Lifespan Health System, Care New England, Brown University's AI research programs, and the defense technology companies serving Naval Station Newport create an AI market anchored by healthcare and research rather than technology-first commercial enterprise. Providence's AI market is small but sophisticated — Brown University's data science programs (Brown was one of the first US universities with a standalone data science institute), Lifespan's large regional health system, and the Boston technology market's spillover create AI demand and talent availability that exceeds what Rhode Island's population suggests. Projects from $20,000. Fixed-price. Full IP. 24-hour response.

sections.title: Providence Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Providence's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Healthcare (Providence's Defining AI Market)
paragraphs: Lifespan Health System (Providence HQ, Rhode Island's largest health system — Rhode Island Hospital, The Miriam Hospital, Hasbro Children's Hospital), Care New England (Women & Infants Hospital, Kent Hospital), and Brown University Health Sciences:
HIPAA-compliant clinical AI with Epic integration for Lifespan's hospital network.
Clinical research AI for Brown University Medical School and Rhode Island Hospital's research programs.
Population health analytics for Rhode Island's small but complete health data ecosystem.
Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Financial Services
paragraphs: Citizens Financial Group (Providence HQ, one of the US's 15 largest banks) is the dominant Providence financial institution — creating credit risk, fraud detection, and customer analytics AI demand. Amica Mutual Insurance (Lincoln, RI HQ) — one of the US's most respected mutual auto and home insurers:
Credit risk and mortgage underwriting ML for Citizens' retail and commercial banking operations.
Insurance underwriting and claims AI for Amica's property and casualty lines.
Cost: $40,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Defense Technology (Naval Station Newport)
paragraphs: Naval Station Newport — home of the Naval War College and Naval Undersea Warfare Center (NUWC) — creates defense technology contractor AI demand in Providence:
Commercial AI for defense contractors' business operations (supply chain, HR, finance).
Maritime and undersea technology AI for commercial applications of defense research concepts.
Classified and ITAR-restricted technical work is outside ClickMasters' scope.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

blocks.heading: Biotech and Education Technology
paragraphs: Brown University's research commercialization, the Brown-affiliated Providence biotech community, and Rhode Island's education technology sector (Bright Horizons, the Highlander Institute) create AI demand across life sciences and EdTech.
Cost: $40,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks

sections.title: Rhode Island AI Regulatory Context
sections.description: Key legal and compliance considerations for Providence AI development.

blocks.heading: Rhode Island Data Transparency and Privacy Protection Act
paragraphs: Rhode Island's consumer privacy law creates specific requirements for AI using Rhode Island consumer data. ClickMasters designs Providence consumer-facing AI with RI privacy law requirements.

blocks.heading: Rhode Island insurance regulation
paragraphs: The RI Division of Banking and Insurance regulates insurance AI applications for Amica and other RI insurers.

blocks.heading: Massachusetts privacy law spillover
paragraphs: Providence's proximity to Boston (about 60 miles) means many Providence organizations operate across the Massachusetts-Rhode Island border and must consider both states' privacy frameworks.
